beats.objective: Decide what crosses the quarantine line

first_night.speaker: patron
first_night.text: {patron.first} {patron.family} wipes the counter of {patron.place} twice. "Wash your hands before you touch the bags. Something's going round the lower floors."

cough.speaker: patron
cough.text: Half the orders tonight come with a request to leave the bag at the door. Behind every door, someone is coughing.

patient_door.speaker: patient
patient_door.text: {patient.first} {patient.family} opens the door a crack, grey and sweating. "{profiteer.name} wants three weeks' wages for the medicine. Who has that?"

healer_ask.speaker: healer
healer_ask.text: {healer.first} {healer.family}, a ward doctor, stops you in the corridor. "I'm close to a cheap cure, but I need samples from the sick floors, fast. Couriers are the only ones still moving."

healer_lab.speaker: healer
healer_lab.text: {healer.first} works through the night. By morning there is a cure in a jar — and {enforcer.name} are sealing the block, on orders paid for by {profiteer.name}.

friend_sick.speaker: friend
friend_sick.text: {friend.first} burns with fever but manages a smile. "Heard {healer.first} has something that works. Heard {enforcer.name} won't let it out of the block."

quarantine.speaker: enforcer
quarantine.text: {enforcer.name} hold the stairwells: nothing in, nothing out. {healer.first}'s cure sits on the wrong side of the line. {disruptor.name} offer a smuggling route. {profiteer.name} offer to buy the formula.

epilogue_smuggle.speaker: healer
epilogue_smuggle.text: The cure moves floor by floor in noodle boxes. The cough fades within a week. {disruptor.name} let everyone know who owes them.

epilogue_obey.speaker: enforcer
epilogue_obey.text: The quarantine holds for a month. Many recover; some don't. {healer.first}'s cure leaves the block only when {enforcer.name} say so.

epilogue_profit.speaker: profiteer
epilogue_profit.text: {profiteer.name} patent the formula and sell it dear. Your account looks healthier than the district.
